summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I fixed two bugs that stopped `python3 main.py` from running: I changed the import in `main.py` from the nonexistent `greetings` module to `greeter`, and I added the missing colon after `def greet(name)` in `greeter.py`. After those changes the program runs cleanly and prints `Hello,
